scope: Independent local review of the materialized static guide, its integrity test, read-only SQLite, preserved raw snapshot and existing audit/source metadata. No network, implementation, deployment, commits or source repairs.

verdict.summary: All 92 literal line refs, 180 route variants, linked stop/platform occurrences, points and road geometries are preserved exactly. Display-only line 42 endpoint derivations have exact unique source evidence and retain raw nulls. However, the package omits one non-transit raw relation member, so full-source/all-member preservation is not established, and the test accepts incorrect line safety flags, duplicate line variants, fabricated summary endpoints and false geometry-verification metadata. No currently invented ETA, provider mappings, operating status or official completeness was found.
verdict.acceptance_boundary: Usable as an explicitly unverified static-display projection with the documented caveats; not an official current line census, trip-navigation graph, timetable, provider-ID mapping or arrival service. Correct the all-member claim/preservation gap and strengthen the safety-critical test before calling the materialization fully verified.

findings.title: One raw member is absent from the entire guide; the test's full-source/exact-membership claim overlooks it

evidence.sqlite_query: SELECT route_id, member_index, element_id, role FROM route_members WHERE route_id='osm:relation:13117573' AND member_index=147;
evidence.not_false_positive_for_relation_members: The other two non-typed members, osm:relation:21376788 at indices 172 and 173 of routes osm:relation:13016691 and osm:relation:13022576, ARE retained in quality.source_audit.direct_relation_members; they are not reported as lost.
evidence.source_anomaly: The raw snapshot identifies the omitted node as leisure=adult_gaming_centre, not a bus stop. Its membership is anomalous source evidence, not a legitimate station to add.
evidence.existing_test_result: PASS, despite this actual omission. The test compares route_stops, route_platforms and route_geometry, never the complete route_members sequence.

findings.impact: The projection cannot round-trip every raw member or fully expose this existing source anomaly. The current omission does not remove a legitimate stop or road segment; the defect is silent evidence loss and overstatement of the integrity guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Retain the exact unclassified member in an explicit raw_members or other_members collection, preserving route ID, index, literal element ID and role. Flag it as unclassified/non-transit evidence and never insert it into stops, platforms, operating service or navigation. Assert the complete ordered route_members list against SQLite, accounting for every member exactly once. If intentionally excluded from this projection, explicitly document that exclusion and narrow the full-source/all-member claims instead.

verification.method: Independent full-route member-list reconstruction from stops, platforms, road segments and diagnostic direct_relation_members, compared against every read-only route_members row; literal ID search of all six guide JSON files; raw snapshot node inspection.

findings.title: Safety-critical line and audit-summary fields can become false while the integrity test remains green

evidence.current_artifact_values: Independent review confirmed the present line flags are all false; raw summary names/endpoints, direction status and component counts match SQL/audit; embedded source_audit and geometry_audit blobs match the audited source files. This is a demonstrated test-coverage defect, not a claim these present fields are wrong.
evidence.mutation_method: Extracted and executed the exact Python String.raw body of bus-guide-integrity.test.mjs. For each case, copied guide JSON into memory, changed one field, recomputed the corresponding manifest bytes/hash in memory, and patched Path.read_text/read_bytes for guide paths only. SQLite and every real guide/test file stayed untouched. Rehashing represents a self-consistent regenerated artifact, rather than bypassing an accidental-corruption check on disk.

executed_mutations.change: Set the first line current_operator_service_verified to true
Append a duplicate of the first variant to its line
Replace a line variant from_raw and to_raw with UNSUPPORTED ENDPOINT
Replace a line variant exact_vertex_component_count with 999

evidence.why: Line membership uses set equality, discarding duplicate multiplicity. The line loop does not assert current_operator_service_verified, name_raw/from_raw/to_raw, direction_status or exact_vertex_component_count. The route loop validates two top-level quality booleans but does not validate the embedded source/geometry audit blobs or their independent-verification flags. File hashes confirm byte consistency, not correctness of unasserted semantics.

findings.impact: A future manual reprojection can falsely certify current operation or traversal orientation in a field a list/map consumer reads, display unsupported summary endpoints or hide connectivity problems, or duplicate a variant, with a passing integrity test. Global false flags do not resolve contradictory per-line/per-variant fields.
findings.recommendation: Assert false current-service flags at the line level; require exact variant cardinality and unique IDs in addition to set membership; compare every variant raw label/endpoint to its exact SQL route; validate source/geometry audit identity and values against pinned audit evidence or independent recomputation; explicitly require unverified orientation and source stop-order semantics. Add negative tests for the demonstrated mutations. Keep manifest hash checks as complementary byte-integrity checks.

verification.method: Five isolated in-memory mutations each accepted by the exact existing test body, with internally consistent memory-only manifest hashes.

test.note: A passing test is not proof of the currently unasserted full raw-member guarantee.

full_collection_checks.ref_4_caution: Source lines contain EXP-4, not exact 4 or EXP4. No additional alias was introduced.

endpoint_derivations.original_same_relation_name_en: Line 42 (Elahiyeh bus station → Shahid Javan bus station)
endpoint_derivations.matching_policy: Exact, case-sensitive full-string equality of the split English endpoint label and facility tags[name:en], searched across all 39 source facilities; no trimming, punctuation repair, translation guessing, proximity or reverse-route fallback.
endpoint_derivations.assessment: Supported as separately identified OSM display evidence, not a raw endpoint repair, operator assertion or verified terminal identity.

future_consumer_requirements: Treat counts as this dated OSM snapshot only. No official current network denominator was obtained; do not advertise all operating city lines or derive an official coverage percentage.

Display endpoint_display with its method/evidence and unverified status; keep from_name/to_name and line from_raw/to_raw null where the source is null. Do not quietly overwrite raw fields with display labels.
Keep literal line identifiers distinct and variant IDs stable. Do not infer 4=EXP-4 or EXP4, normalize 38.1=38/1, deduplicate equal stop sequences, or manufacture missing reverse service.

Render each road geometry as its own original segment. There are 35 routes with disconnected exact-vertex graphs (32 with two components, three with three), 18 non-loop variants lacking an exact reversed raw endpoint pair, and no operator-verified traversal orientation. Do not stitch/reverse ways or use this projection as verified navigation.
Keep stop positions and platforms separate and retain repeated visits and the platform_exit_only role. The unequal counts on 178 variants are not a station-pairing instruction.

All 2196 stop elements are included, not all route-linked: 100 have no imported route occurrence; 15 have no name; osm:way:51881417 has null lat/lon and is an area facility. Never turn null coordinates into zero or an invented centroid.

The guide contains 3243 linked platform occurrences covering 1150 distinct elements, not an independent complete export of all 1210 platform table rows. Sixty unlinked platforms remain in SQLite. Use SQLite/raw catalogue when those records or full platform tags/ref hints are needed.

Facility candidates are not necessarily urban terminals: only 19 of 39 carry a municipal operator tag, and none is officially terminal-verified. A facility's geometry is not automatically a boarding point.
Stop ref_raw and OSM IDs are source identities, not municipal/Neshan/provider mappings. Leave ETA/headways/current-service status unknown until independently evidenced.
Verify the pinned source hash and artifact manifest before consumption. Raw-database rebuilds do not automatically regenerate this reviewed projection. Preserve ODbL and OSM attribution.

source_metadata_review.limitations: Existing source observations were read locally, not revalidated over the network. A dated news aggregate is not an official ref-level denominator. The newly inspected third-party PDF is different from the 2019 PDF and carries 2024-10-14 creation metadata, but that is not an operating validity date or a complete current catalogue. None of these research leads authorizes changing the preserved source or promoting additional guide routes.
